reviews.reviewer: Safety Score v10.01 primary-source whole-allocation renewal
reviews.rationale: Ethereum block 26107640 (0x7d2c1c6a253d860b843691c64c3acd2e09530ff4f9db6f08351efeb6d8f60f2a), timestamp 1790980283 / 2026-10-02T22:31:23Z, pins the evidence date. The three current queue strategies' recorded current_debt sums exactly to vault totalDebt, establishing coverage of all recorded funded allocation; totalIdle is zero, with 120 wei of unaccounted BOLD dust at the vault. The vault owns each strategy's entire current share supply; each strategy deploys BOLD to its exact WETH, wstETH or rETH Liquity Stability Pool. Current compounded deposits exceed recorded debts; they are observations, not substituted vault accounting. The deployed vault implementation, all three verified strategy sources, their immutable TokenizedStrategy delegate and pool offset/withdrawal code establish on-chain custody and no local borrowing surface. Vault debt denotes assets allocated to strategies, not borrowed liabilities. Strategies deposit via provideToSP and withdraw via withdrawFromSP; pool offset burns deposited BOLD to absorb liquidated borrower debt in exchange for collateral. Retain liquidation-loss-absorption as correlated capital reuse across the common Liquity protocol and ETH-linked collateral branches, not zero reuse. Yearn's yBOLD docs corroborate that allocation and warn principal can be affected by Stability Pool losses and collateral-sale execution. On-chain availableWithdrawLimit/maxWithdraw readings establish native BOLD view limits only; this review obtains no exact-complete same-notional holder-to-USD execution, bounded USD fees or stressed settlement, so measured unwind remains unknown and earns no new credit. Pool withdrawals must leave MIN_BOLD_IN_SP, and documentation's no-wait/no-fee statement is not proof of stressed realization. This review grants no off-chain legal segregation, bankruptcy priority, or guarantee against future strategy reallocations.

reviews.reviewer: DataCWrapperLocal: exact verified source and pinned allocation census
reviews.rationale: The immutable canonical Ethereum sDOLA holds all principal as its balanceOf claim in the immutable DolaSavings account, whose actual DOLA balance equals totalSupply and the wrapper stake exactly; the wrapper has zero idle DOLA. The exhaustive principal allocation roster is this one fixed savings account. Deposits and DBR-auction DOLA inflows stake there; withdrawals unstake; the account transfers principal only to the withdrawing stake owner. No strategy registry, external principal loan, borrowing function or arbitrary call exists. DBR rewards are minted then auctioned for additional DOLA, not financed by lending deposits. Governance/operator settings change reward budgets, auction K and role assignments. Savings governance may sweep only DOLA above totalSupply, independently confirmed by a simulated 1 DOLA sweep reverting CANNOT SWEEP USER DOLA. Wrapper governance can sweep non-DBR idle tokens (including donated idle DOLA); this power is retained, not described as legal segregation. Historical CCIP receipt liabilities and governance re-enable powers remain bridge/control risks; this review concerns the canonical principal book and does not clear them or claim remote supply is zero. Parent DOLA backing remains inherited.

reviews.reviewer: DataCWrapperLocal: exact verified source and pinned allocation census
reviews.rationale: Ethereum and BNB Chain SavingsUsdd are immutable, one-parent savings claims. The exhaustive source-defined route is wrapper -> UsddJoin -> Vat/Pot: Join burns deposited parent USDD and credits internal Vat USDD; Pot holds internal Vat balances and records pie. Withdrawals reverse Pot/Vat movements and Join mints parent USDD. Both wrappers and Joins have zero token USDD at the pinned blocks; each wrapper totalSupply equals its Pot pie and the Pot aggregate Pie. Neither wrapper nor Pot has an allocator, strategy list, lending approval, borrowing function or arbitrary call surface. Pot administrators may change dsr/vow, authorize wards or cage; Join may authorize wards or cage, and Vat retains parent protocol issuance/CDP powers. These powers and global Smart Allocator cash-reserve investments remain parent/control exposure, not a local reinvestment of savings-token principal. No legal segregation or bankruptcy protection is asserted.
